name: std::logical_not<void>
intro: std::logical_not<void> is a specialization of std::logical_not with parameter and return type deduced.

sections.title: Member functions
sections.text:
operator()

  applies operator! to its argument 
 (public member function)

std::logical_not<void>::operator()



 template< class T >

constexpr auto operator()( T&& arg ) const


    -> decltype(!std::forward<T>(arg));
  
  



Returns the result of !std::forward<T>(arg).

 Parameters




 arg

 -

 value to apply logical NOT to

 Return value
!std::forward<T>(arg).
